---
name: Erratum
about: Report a factual, bibliographic or numerical error in the book
title: "[Erratum] "
labels: erratum
---

## Where

Chapter, section heading, and the sentence or figure involved. If the error is in a register entry,
give its identifier (`C7-003`, `B-005`).

## What is wrong

State the error as precisely as you can.

## What it should say

If you know the correction, give it, with a source.

## How you checked

The book's claims are recorded with their verification status in `verify/claims.csv`. If your
correction contradicts an entry whose status is `verified_metadata` or `verified_via_text`, say what
you checked and how — a database, a copy of the source, an archive link, or a page number.

## Anything else

Optional. Corrections are credited in the changelog unless you ask otherwise.
